blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-19. The sole catalogued deployment is Ethereum 0x4ce1ac8f43e0e5bd7a346a98af777bf8fbea1981; although the census returned no circulation figure, totalSupply()=54907107424502271722527317 raw share units at Ethereum block 26224759 (2026-10-19T06:13:59+00:00), hash 0x2e777b94fc023c9fffa581f3cac554f363407ab8706bc77304323de6ba0f7993, so Ethereum contains 100% of observed native shares. Its current BurnableTokenizedShareManager implementation is 0x000000000c79d2b5cd58ae545afc83030233d7b6. ShareManager.updateChecks unconditionally rejects blacklisted senders/recipients; zero flags do not disable that check. SET_ACCOUNT_INFO_ROLE currently has zero members on vault 0x014e6da8f283c4af65b2aa0f201438680a004452, and SET_FLAGS_ROLE also has zero members at that pin (getRoleMemberCount=0); the default-admin holder 0x0dd73341d6158a72b4d224541f1094188f57076e holds neither role, but can grant either. All six decoded share flags are zero. The token proxy admin 0x98a876b68eecb730e692d0ec699b3378bdc71d6f is owned by 5-of-8 Safe 0x81698f87c6482bf1ce9bfcfc0f103c4a0adf0af0. Therefore direct configurable restrictions, the grantable empty blacklist/flag roles, and token upgrades set Possible, not an active role-assigned direct blacklist verdict or an observed historical freeze. Earlier block 26196064 (2026-10-15T06:16:59Z) recorded zero flags, a 15-role top-level census and eight unpaused queues. USDC remains the declared parent claim, but direct Possible takes precedence; the pooled protocol-strategy reserve row is not treated as measured USDC/USDT/USDe reserve weights.

oracleRisk.summary: earnUSD uses privileged internal Oracle reports for queue and share valuation. The deployment registry names a 3-of-8 Oracle Updater Safe, whose quorum was re-read at the October 15 pin; the documented Timelock has zero minimum delay. The two named Ethereum underlying Oracle proxies still use the shared internal-price implementation. Current material downstream lending, collateral and cross-chain pricing paths and their weights remain unreconciled, including the additional earnUSDe Robinhood deployment in Lido's current registry.

branchApplicability.rationale: Review covers exact earnUSD Oracle 0x827044735c9708a2cf850e7ea37eba43bc786028, its pinned implementation and USDC/USDT/USDe reports. A complete position/collateral oracle branch census and matched material strategy weights remain unestablished.
